slices.focus: Caleb redesigns workshop format from slide presentations to hands-on follow-through program with document packets, call-back sheets, and color-coded checklists
slices.summary: After weak next-step completion from the first two corridor workshops, Caleb strips down the presentation and rebuilds the format around take-home document packets, color-coded checklists, and call-back sheets. Sharon lets him test the new approach on the same corridor, shifting his role from presenter to follow-through manager.
open_loops: Fix confusing wording in packet before next session while keeping core structure stable
Add next-action field to call-back sheets
Ask 2-3 targeted households how they used the checklist at home
decisions: Caleb expanded the corridor workshop series from presentation-led meetings into a hands-on follow-through program built
